name: I'm Dreaming of a Harajuku Christmas
source:
Harajuku is a corner in Shibuya, Tokyo, known for its inhabitants' unique fashion. With your lolita fashion sense (and your cute gyaru girlfriend), tour around the vibrant shops in the area and become closer to your girlfriend!

[From [url=https://studioyurika.itch.io/harajukuchristmas]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
原宿是东京涩谷的一个角落，以其居民独特的时尚而闻名。带着你的洛丽塔时尚感（和你可爱的辣妹女友），游览该地区充满活力的商店，与你的女友更加亲密！

[来自[url=https://studioyurika.itch.io/harajukuchristmas]itch.io[/url]]
